sources.title: What happened to the old model? It was so much better
sources.snippet: About 2 months ago Dalle on Bing quietly updated their model into one that produces much more artificial, rendered, digital designs. It used to be fantastic at generating things like realistic animals, reptiles, birds, as well as just about everything else. Is there any way to access this previous model?
